name: Metal Sentinel live metal widgets
description: Official embeddable live widgets for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper, nickel, aluminum, zinc, and lead in USD. Already used by Alien/Infinity Radio.

name: Internet Archive APIs
description: Search and retrieve public audio, video, books, metadata, and playable media used throughout the Phi media flows.

name: MediaWiki / Wikipedia API
description: Public search, page extracts, summaries, images, and structured encyclopedia retrieval used by Infinity and Omni fallbacks.

name: Crossref REST API
description: Public scholarly metadata and DOI research lookup used by the Phi research/news stack.

name: DuckDuckGo Instant Answer API
description: Public instant-answer retrieval used by earlier Infinity research flows as a lightweight no-key source.

name: GitHub public REST API
description: Public repository and commit data for public repos; already used in Phi commit/status panels without a paid API.
access: No key for public reads; rate limits apply

name: Orange Brook SearXNG
description: The existing Phi search backend for web and image retrieval, including Code Phi plan and Cloud Browser inspection routes.
